articles.summary: ‍Vaduz, Liechtenstein – April 1, 2025 Polymath Robotics, the global leader in autonomy software for industrial and maritime vehicles, today proudly announces a groundbreaking collaboration with the Royal Navy of Liechtenstein.
articles.title: Polymath Robotics Blog | Polymath Robotics Awarded 10-Year Programme of Record to Deliver Autonomous Vessels for the the Royal Navy of Liechtenstein
